Subject: Proposal: Six-Week Invoice Handling Pilot — Decision Requested

Hi Morgan,

Thanks for our recent conversation. I'd like to formally propose the six-week pilot to assess invoice handling on the agreed terms.

Scope and fee:
- Duration: six weeks, scoped exclusively to invoice handling; production rollout excluded.
- Fee: $30,000 fixed.
- Target: 20% shorter handling time. We will establish a clean baseline in week one so progress is measured credibly.

Why move now: without an existing baseline, the pilot is the most credible way to test impact before any broader commitment. The fixed fee and contained scope keep exposure low while the answer is built.

Before any client data is touched, security approval is required. We can run onboarding in parallel so that, once cleared, the team moves directly into week one.

Decision requested: please confirm approval of the pilot scope and the $30,000 fixed fee, subject to security clearance, so we can lock in a start date.

Happy to walk through any detail.

Best,
Jordan
Engagement Lead
